The '''father''' of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] leader [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual. Hondo's father lived on [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]] during Ohnaka's childhood. He and [[Hondo Ohnaka's mother/Legends|his wife]] were poor swindlers and they sold Hondo as a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] to "honor" the Weequay god [[Quay]].<ref name="TCW Ultimate Battles" />
